decisions.reason: The GIS solution platform was given its own page in 2019 and appears to be core to the firm's map.apps-based business, so dropping it is unlikely.

Mobile field data capture is a steady need for GIS customers such as utilities and public authorities, and the product kept its own page across years, though competition from the platform vendor's own mobile apps adds some risk.
The search extension was still receiving version updates in 2019 and complements the firm's web map framework, which suggests ongoing maintenance and customer demand.
